heading: Definitions
lead: In sections 60101 to 60104 of this title:

tree.heading: Crime of violence
tree.text: The term “crime of violence” has the same meaning as in section 924(c)(3) of title 18.

tree.heading: Private prisoner transport company
tree.text: The term “private prisoner transport company” means any entity, other than the United States, a State, or an inferior political subdivision of a State, which engages in the business of the transporting for compensation, individuals committed to the custody of any State or of an inferior political subdivision of a State, or any attempt thereof.

tree.heading: Violent prisoner
tree.text: The term “violent prisoner” means any individual in the custody of a State or an inferior political subdivision of a State who has previously been convicted of or is currently charged with a crime of violence or any similar statute of a State or the inferior political subdivisions of a State, or any attempt thereof.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 13726a of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
